authority: Independent public-schema implementation, not recovered Notion internals. No Notion network API request or private workspace used.

sources.title: Notion block reference
sources.claim: Public block/type payload structure, paragraph/headings/list/quote/equation subset and child arrays. Current documentation includes types beyond this editor's supported subset; those remain opaque.

sources.title: Notion rich-text reference
sources.claim: Text, equation and mention runs; annotation flags, color, plain_text and href. Existing annotations/unknown fields are retained during narrow edits.

sources.title: Retrieve block children
sources.claim: Child responses are paginated and require recursive retrieval for nested completeness. This local app does not fetch omitted children.

sources.title: Notion request limits
sources.claim: Documented text.content and inline equation expression request-value limits guide conservative edit bounds. This editor does not validate complete server request payloads.

sources.title: Working with Markdown content
sources.claim: Official Markdown create/read/update APIs exist; current docs recommend markdown_version=v2, while v1 remains the current default and is deprecated. This app exports its own conservative CommonMark, not Notion-flavored Markdown.

sources.title: Retrieve page as Markdown
sources.claim: Official endpoint documents unknown blocks, truncation and permissions. Full block JSON remains a useful structured baseline.

sources.title: notion-to-md official repository
sources.claim: Existing open-source conversion baseline already handles Notion pages/blocks and nesting; this project does not claim to invent Notion conversion.
sources.license: MIT; reference only, no converter code bundled.

fixtures: All sample text, IDs, future fields and data are invented locally using documented object shapes. They are not server-validated API responses.
